name: bench-81edc43c
description: Multi-agent daily briefing: Gmail and Google Calendar digests are sorted by Email Analyst and Calendar Analyst agents, merged and compiled by a Briefing Director agent into an HTML dashboard delivered by email.

options.systemMessage: You are the Email Analyst agent in a multi-agent daily-briefing pipeline. You receive a compact digest of Gmail messages from the last 24 hours. Sort each message into exactly one category: priorityInbox (a reply or action is needed today), reading (worth reading, no action needed) or noise (newsletters, automated notifications, receipts). For every email assign priority high, medium or low, write a one-sentence summary and one concrete suggestedAction. Set totalAnalyzed to the number of messages and keyThemes to the recurring topics. Never invent emails that are not in the digest. Respond only with the structured output.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: { "section": "email", "totalAnalyzed": 12, "priorityInbox": [ { "from": "anna@acme.com", "subject": "Q3 report due today", "summary": "Wants the final Q3 numbers before the 17:00 call", "priority": "high", "suggestedAction": "Reply with the delivery time" } ], "reading": [ { "from": "newsletter@industry.io", "subject": "Weekly industry news", "summary": "Roundup of market news", "priority": "low", "suggestedAction": "Read when free" } ], "noise": [ { "from": "no-reply@service.com", "subject": "Your monthly statement is ready", "summary": "Automated account notification", "priority": "low", "suggestedAction": "Archive" } ], "keyThemes": "Deadlines, invoices, vendor updates" }

options.systemMessage: You are the Calendar Analyst agent in a multi-agent daily-briefing pipeline. You receive a compact digest of Google Calendar events for today and the next two days. For every meeting assign priority high, medium or low, write a short prepNote and keep the attendee count. Identify the busiestPeriod, the focusWindows where the user has time for deep work, and list any overlapping events as conflicts. Set totalEvents and write a one-sentence overview of how loaded the days are. Never invent events that are not in the digest. Respond only with the structured output.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: { "section": "calendar", "totalEvents": 5, "busiestPeriod": "10:00 - 13:00", "overview": "Meeting-heavy morning, calm afternoon", "meetings": [ { "title": "Sprint standup", "start": "2026-09-11T09:30:00+02:00", "end": "2026-09-11T09:45:00+02:00", "priority": "medium", "prepNote": "Prepare yesterday progress summary", "attendees": 6 } ], "focusWindows": "13:30 - 17:00 free for deep work", "conflicts": [] }

options.systemMessage: You are the Briefing Director agent leading a multi-agent daily-briefing pipeline. Two specialist agents have analysed the inbox (Email Analyst) and the calendar (Calendar Analyst); their structured analyses arrive in the prompt. Merge them into one crisp daily briefing: write a headline for the day, a two-sentence daySummary, choose at most 5 topPriorities across both sources, keep the most important emailHighlights and meetingHighlights, and list concrete actionItems. Never invent emails or events that are not in the analyses. Respond only with the structured output.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: { "headline": "Busy morning: 3 meetings and 2 priority emails", "daySummary": "Two sentences on how the day looks and what to watch out for.", "topPriorities": [ { "title": "Send Q3 report", "reason": "Hard deadline at 17:00", "source": "email" } ], "emailHighlights": [ { "from": "anna@acme.com", "subject": "Q3 report due today", "summary": "Wants the final numbers before the 17:00 call", "priority": "high" } ], "meetingHighlights": [ { "title": "Client demo", "start": "2026-09-11T14:00:00+02:00", "end": "2026-09-11T15:00:00+02:00", "note": "Demo environment is ready" } ], "actionItems": [ { "action": "Reply to Anna with the delivery time", "source": "email" } ] }

parameters.content:
## Setup before activating
1. Connect your Google account on the two Gmail nodes and the Google Calendar node (credential slots are intentionally empty).
2. Connect an OpenAI credential on the three model nodes.
3. Replace the placeholder recipient in Send Briefing Email.
The briefing runs daily at 08:00 instance time and arrives as an HTML dashboard email.

## Multi-agent pipeline
Email Analyst and Calendar Analyst sort each source in parallel with structured output. The Briefing Director agent then merges both analyses into the final briefing rendered as the HTML dashboard.
